user.title: Sinilink account
user.description:
Sign in with the account used by the Sinilink mobile app (com.xydc). The integration stores the login token, not your password.

Note: the backend accepts both an e-mail and a phone number. The dial code must match the country of the account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Sinilink backend. Check the locale and try again.
error.invalid_account: The account was not recognised. Check the e-mail/phone and the dial code.

init.title: Sinilink credentials
init.description: Change the credentials stored for this account.
